name: THM_Exposed Passwords in Command Lines
description: Detecção para credenciais que estão expostas em linhas de comandos em alguns executáveis. Essa credencial pode ser capturada e explorada.
alert_description:
Foi detectada a exposição de credenciais em linha de comando no host $agent_hostname, executada pelo usuário $actor_effective_username. Essas credenciais podem ser capturadas e exploradas por agentes maliciosos, representando risco de comprometimento do sistema.
Para mais informações, consultar via Drill-Down.
investigation_query_link:
dataset = xdr_data
| fields agent_hostname, actor_effective_username, action_process_image_command_line, action_process_image_path, _time, event_type, agent_os_type, event_sub_type
| filter agent_os_type = ENUM.AGENT_OS_WINDOWS
| filter event_type = PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START 
| filter ((action_process_image_command_line contains "puttyng.exe" or action_process_image_command_line contains "putty.exe" or action_process_image_command_line contains "plink.exe") and action_process_image_command_line contains " -pw ") or (action_process_image_command_line contains "mobaxterm.exe" and action_process_image_command_line contains "sshpass -p") or action_process_image_command_line contains "mremoteng.exe" or action_process_image_command_line contains "psexec.exe" or action_process_image_command_line contains "psexesvc.exe" or action_process_image_command_line contains "securecrt.exe" or action_process_image_command_line contains "psftp.exe" or action_process_image_command_line contains "pscp.exe" or action_process_image_command_line contains "winscp.exe" or action_process_image_command_line contains "SCHTASKS.exe"
| filter action_process_image_command_line contains " -pw " or action_process_image_command_line contains " -password " or action_process_image_command_line contains " -pass " or action_process_image_command_line contains " /password " or action_process_image_command_line contains " /pass " or action_process_image_command_line contains " -p " or action_process_image_command_line contains "/rp "
| filter not(action_process_image_path in ("*shimgen.exe*", "*ab_sshplink.exe*"))
| dedup agent_hostname, action_process_image_command_line
| filter action_process_image_command_line not contains "<SERVICE_ACCOUNT>"
